Name: DE-Attendances
Statement:
select  Day,
        usl.Id as UserId,
        usl.Name as [User],
        Hours,
        Minutes,
        OffSetTotalMinutes,
        TardinessTotalMinutes,
        BreakTotalMinutes,
        HomeOffice,
        HalfDay,
        Time,
        Type,
        AdjustedTime,
        Motive,
        Offset,
        OffsetMinutes
from    Attendance atc
            join AttendanceDetail atd on atd.Attendance = atc.Oid
            join UserLookup usl on usl.Id = atc.[User]
where   (@From is null or atc.Day >= @From) and
        (@To is null or atc.Day <= @To)
